messages:
Ashwin (CS): Quick heads-up — Verdant just submitted their vendor security package. High-level: missing a couple SOC2 control attestations and one DPA appendix for data deletion. Renewal health moved from green to yellow.
Maria (Customer Success): Ugh. Any specific controls flagged?
Ashwin (CS): They flagged 'change management' evidence (CC6) and 'data retention/deletion' appendix. Also asked for an export/erasure flow diagram.
Priya (Security): I pulled the upload. SOC2 report is there but no control owner attestation for CC6. We can accept a signed control owner note + artifact list. For deletion flow we need sequence diagram + sample audit log lines.
Jenna (Legal): On the DPA appendix — they requested a clause update around 3rd-party subprocessors and a bespoke retention window. We can offer our standard addendum but need legal review for the retention ask. @Tom FYI if retention impacts logs/exports.
Tom (Eng): Retention window change could affect S3 lifecycle + audit tooling. If they want shorter retention for nonprod, we might need a config flag. ETA for a short PR: 2 business days.
Maria (Customer Success): Can we triage with Verdant tomorrow? They want resolution before renewal meeting next Wed. I can escalate if we run a blocker.
Priya (Security): I'll draft a control owner attestation template they can sign today. Also I'll export example audit log snippets.
Jenna (Legal): I'll draft the DPA appendix response and propose our allowed retention bounds. If they require BYOK or KMS changes we escalate to sales/infra.
Ashwin (CS): Plan: 1) Priya sends attestation + logs 2) Jenna sends DPA addendum reply 3) Tom confirms technical feasibility for requested retention 4) Maria schedules 30-min triage with Verdant. Anyone object? :thumbsup:
Tom (Eng): +1. I can prep a small doc: "Retention options & impact".
Maria (Customer Success): I'll book triage for tomorrow 10:30am PT and add Verdant's security contact. Calendar invite in a bit.
onboarding-bot: Ticket CS-4721 status -> evidence_requested by Ashwin (CS)
Priya (Security): Uploaded attestation template + sample logs to the ticket. Link: https://rwd-internal/secure/CS-4721/evidence
Jenna (Legal): Draft ready, pushing to ticket as draft.
Ashwin (CS): Thanks team — aim is to restore health score to green before renewal. Maria, please ping if Verdant asks for an exec one-pager; we have a short "security posture summary" we can attach.
Maria (Customer Success): Will do. If we need any odd artifacts I’ll raise a quick CFU.
Tom (Eng): Noted. I’ll add estimated effort to ticket (low/medium).
Ashwin (CS): Closing note — put any final artifacts into CS-4721 and tag @Priya. We'll follow up in the triage. :raised_hands:
